name: Isogram
blurb: Determine if a word or phrase is an isogram.
instructions:
# Instructions

Determine if a word or phrase is an isogram.

An isogram (also known as a "non-pattern word") is a word or phrase without a repeating letter, however spaces and hyphens are allowed to appear multiple times.

Examples of isograms:

- lumberjacks
- background
- downstream
- six-year-old

The word _isograms_, however, is not an isogram, because the s repeats.

example_solution:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
        PROGRAM-ID. ISOGRAM.
        ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
        DATA DIVISION.
        WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
        01 WS-PHRASE PIC X(60).
        01 WS-UPPER-CASE PIC X(26) VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
        01 WS-UPPER-ARRAY REDEFINES WS-UPPER-CASE.
          02 WS-UPPER-CHAR PIC X OCCURS 26 TIMES INDEXED BY CHAR-INDEX.
        01 WS-LOWER-CASE PIC X(26) VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'.
        01 WS-MATCH-COUNT PIC 99.
        01 WS-RESULT PIC 99.
        PROCEDURE DIVISION.
        ISOGRAM.
      * Uppercase the sentence
          INSPECT WS-PHRASE
            CONVERTING WS-LOWER-CASE to WS-UPPER-CASE.

      * count each letter in alphabet until more than one
          MOVE 1 TO WS-RESULT.
          SET CHAR-INDEX TO 0.
          PERFORM VARYING CHAR-INDEX
            FROM 1
            BY 1
            UNTIL CHAR-INDEX > 26
                MOVE 0 TO WS-MATCH-COUNT
                INSPECT WS-PHRASE
                    TALLYING WS-MATCH-COUNT
                    FOR ALL WS-UPPER-CHAR(CHAR-INDEX)
                IF WS-MATCH-COUNT > 1
                    MOVE 0 TO WS-RESULT
                    EXIT PERFORM
                END-IF
          END-PERFORM.
test_code:
TestCase "empty string"
	MOVE '' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "isogram with only lower case characters"
	MOVE 'isogram' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "word with one duplicated character"
	MOVE 'eleven' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "word with one duplicated character from the end of the alphabet"
	MOVE 'zzyzx' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "longest reported english isogram"
	MOVE 'subdermatoglyphic' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "word with duplicated character in mixed case"
	MOVE 'Alphabet' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "word with duplicated character in mixed case, lowercase first"
	MOVE 'alphAbet' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "hypothetical isogrammic word with hyphen"
	MOVE 'thumbscrew-japingly' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "hypothetical word with duplicated character following hyphen"
	MOVE 'thumbscrew-jappingly' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "isogram with duplicated hyphen"
	MOVE 'six-year-old' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "made-up name that is an isogram"
	MOVE 'Emily Jung Schwartzkopf' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "duplicated character in the middle"
	MOVE 'accentor' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "same first and last characters"
	MOVE 'angola' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "word with duplicated character and with two hyphens"
	MOVE 'up-to-date' TO WS-PHRASE
	PERFORM ISOGRAM
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0
